quarterly_data.quarter: Tower Semiconductor press release: OpenLight and Tower Semiconductor Expand PH18DA Photonics (08-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: OpenLight's photonic Process Design Kit (PDK) for Tower's PH18DA indium phosphide (InP)-on-silicon photonics platform is now available in Cadence's EDA tools, so customers can design PICs for fabrication on PH18DA within a standard IC design environment. The PH18DA platform integrates active photonic components - lasers, modulators and amplifiers - into a single monolithic PIC, for optical interconnects, AI infrastructure and sensing. Tower VP of Customer Design Enablement and Reliability Samir Chaudhry: the capability 'enables customers to streamline development of 400G and 1.6T laser-integrated photonic integrated circuits', with co-optimized PIC and EIC designs for next-generation near- and co-packaged optics (NPO/CPO).
quarterly_data.figure: PH18DA PDK available in Cadence EDA tools; 400G and 1.6T laser-integrated PICs
